title: Retain exact original checkpoint batch inputs through restart before settlement
outcome: Restart preserves only the validated pending batch inputs of a retained original checkpoint until its exact authoritative receipt can convert them to owed binds, without reviving launch credit or granting successor authority.
acceptance: A fresh host preserves pending batch inputs narrowly matched to a validated retained original checkpoint and converts them only on its exact Checkpointed receipt; unrelated or unprovable pending inputs keep their existing lost-credit behavior.

Actual SQLite cuts before Accepted and after a non-owning Accepted retention, followed by a new AppState and supported recovery, prove non-empty exact batch targets and evidence survive and settle once without replacement provider delivery.
Restart recovery never binds a successor's pending batch, fabricates launch verification, or confirms an original while its matched receipt effects have been silently discarded.
